svg.title: E06: Joint harness–policy evolution collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Evolution · A² A3 · cycle role collaboration
Adapt runtime structure and policy together.
Runtime harness and model policy can both change.
An evolution round evaluates task behavior and
proposes changes to either or both.
The selected pair is evaluated as a pair with
attribution for harness and policy changes.
Policy and harness variants are versioned
Results identify the evaluated pair and
A policy gain is not reported as a harness
Failed candidates or incompatible pairs are
1 trace(run) → 2 propose(joint_change) → 3 evaluate(candidate) → 4 accept(pair) → 5 deploy(runtime) → 6 rollback(policy)
Evidence: 1/41 repositories, 1/36 families; 1 trajectories (1 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: 0 supported, 0 unresolved, 1 rejected.
Variation: Curated pairs, coevolution, alternating optimization, and ablation controls.
Negative control: Retraining only the model with a fixed harness is not joint evolution.
